data.content: During the municipal elections of October 2025, we collaborated with the Democratic League of Kosova (LDK) and the Mayor of Prishtina, Përparim Rama.

Following the successful 2021 campaign and the victory of Përparim Rama, a win that marked a significant party triumph by returning LDK to power after several years in opposition, the Mayor once again entrusted us with the creative and strategic direction of the campaign. This trust was a direct result of the impact and success achieved during the previous campaign.

Once again, this campaign could not be ordinary. It was built under the slogan “Prishtina Beyond,” reflecting the continuity of the vision and the ambition to take the city further, beyond expectations and previously set boundaries.

We designed and produced a wide range of campaign materials. This included creating Përparim Rama’s personal Wikipedia page, the official campaign website, as well as producing a large volume of printed and digital materials. In addition, we developed thematic mini-campaigns, organized various events, and carried out numerous supporting activities that strengthened the campaign’s presence and message.

The campaign was built around three core pillars: Prishtina of commitment, Prishtina of work, and Prishtina beyond. These pillars served as the backbone of the communication strategy and the overall campaign narrative.

One of the most innovative elements was the development of an interactive, map-based platform www.prishtina.work, where citizens could explore all projects completed during the first term, those currently underway, and those planned for the future. This platform enabled citizens to better understand even the less visible initiatives, significantly increasing transparency and trust in the municipal governance.
We created an engaging campaign where people could search and find elements in the map (like a scavenger hunt).
The platform created a huge buzz in town, and played a key role in the outcome of the elections by showcasing all the project in the palm of the hand.
During the October and November elections in 2021, we cooperated with The Democratic League of Kosova (LDK) along with the well-known architect and urban planner Përparim Rama.
Our agency worked on the election campaign for both rounds.

The local elections of 17 October ‘21 had a significant importance for the city of Prishtina and its citizens. The citizens were in search of a candidate who had a vision and would know how to build a city they will love and dream of.
This was a party triumph as well, since LDK after being in opposition for few years came back into power.

We designed and produced different materials for both rounds. We created Përparim Rama's personal page in Wikipedia, the website, produced many printed, digital materials, mini-campaigns, events, and other following activities.

The main symbol of the campaign that followed the elections was the figure of a tricolour flower: blue, green, and yellow. Each of the colours had its meaning, Green was for Clean Prishtina, Blue for Practical Prishtina, and Yellow for Prishtina of Experiences.

The second phase was the runoff, an important step towards victory, but this was a bigger challenge, our responsibilities grew, and our work doubled, but the results were visible, Rama went towards victory.
We created the website for the candidate Përparim Rama, where the citizens of Prishtina had the opportunity to read his plan, biography and follow all Rama's activities during the campaign.
